title: calycadenia multiglandulosa var. cephalotes
intro: Calycadenia multiglandulosa var. cephalotes, commonly known as Purple Calycadenia, is a plant species in the sunflower family, characterized by its purple flowers and tall, leafy stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Purple Calycadenia include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
